name: com.precellence-service/paris-chauffeur
title: Precellence Service — Paris chauffeur prices
description: Paris private chauffeur prices incl. VAT: transfers, hourly hire 3-12 h, full day. Read-only.

tools.name: obtenir_devis
tools.description: Prices including VAT, per vehicle, for a private chauffeur trip in Paris and the Île-de-France region (airports, stations, hotels, addresses), or for hourly chauffeur hire, computed by the Precellence Service website pricing engine. Hourly hire (type "hourly": chauffeur at your disposal by the hour, half day or full day, "as directed"; French « mise à disposition »): 3 to 12 h in one day, waiting, 40 km per hour, tolls and fuel included; pickup anywhere in metropolitan France at Paris prices; from a ski resort or abroad: "on_request" with the reason, contacts and a pre-filled quote form; a week (6 days × 8 h): duration_unit "week", priced, booked on written request; over 12 h a day or other multi-day hire: written quote. Returns one price per vehicle class (or "on_request" with a clear reason), and a pre-filled booking link (booking_url) to the website. This tool does NOT book and does NOT take any payment: the traveller books and pays on the website only, where the same price is recomputed and then guaranteed. No card details are used or needed by this tool. Addresses are plain text, ideally the full postal address with the postcode; a station, airport or terminal name also works. Date and time are Paris local time. A well-known Paris place (palaces, 5-star hotels), a street with its city or postcode, an arrondissement alone ("Paris 13", "75013": its town hall), a city alone or a published destination alone ("Lyon", "Reims") gives a price with exact_address_required (address_estimate): the website asks for the exact address before payment; price_is_estimate is true only when that price may still change with the exact address, false for a fixed price (Paris ↔ CDG / Orly, Paris ↔ Lyon). A name shared by several places ("Valence", "Saint-Denis", "La Rochelle", "13e arrondissement", a street found in several cities) returns status "on_request", reason "address_ambiguous" and the candidates (each reason.candidates[].value can be sent back as from / to); the tool never picks one by default. Shared server limits: 30 computed quotes per minute and 5000 units per day for all users; identical requests within 10 minutes return the same cached answer. Fair use: The automatic quote (public API and MCP server) is free and shared by all assistants. To keep it free, address and route computations are capped each month for all assistants together, and bursts are limited (60 computed quotes per minute per IP address for the API, 30 per minute for the whole MCP server). Always answered, even at the monthly limit: trips between a Paris address with a postcode (75001 to 75020, 75116) and an airport, a main Paris railway station, Disneyland, La Défense or Versailles, which have a fixed price, and hourly chauffeur hire (by the hour, half day or full day, wherever it starts), which needs no route computation. The places of the tariff (airports, stations, destinations) are recognised by their name, and French addresses with a postcode are located with the Base Adresse Nationale (IGN Géoplateforme, Licence Ouverte). At the monthly limit: a normal answer, not an error, with status "quota_reached", a plain-language message, the pre-filled booking link (booking_url) and, when the trip has a fixed price, that price. On a burst: HTTP 429 (API) or JSON-RPC error -31429 (MCP), with the waiting time (Retry-After) and the same link. What to do: give the full postal address with the postcode (for example "15 avenue Montaigne, 75008 Paris") rather than a hotel name, then send the traveller to booking_url: the website computes the exact price at once. A block is never an outage: the website and the booking link always work. FR : devis TTC par véhicule, transfert ou mise à disposition (chauffeur à l'heure), sans réservation ni paiement (lien booking_url vers le site). AR : عرض سعر شامل الضريبة لكل سيارة، دون حجز أو دفع (رابط booking_url إلى الموقع). ES : presupuesto con IVA por vehículo, sin reserva ni pago (enlace booking_url al sitio web).

from.description: Pickup, as text: full postal address with the postcode (number, street, postcode, city) — best —, or a station, airport or terminal name; a hotel name alone may need a paid lookup (see fair use).

to.description: Drop-off, as text, same advice as "from". Required unless type is "hourly".

time.description: Pickup time, Paris local time, HH:MM (9:30 and 9h30 accepted).

class.description: Vehicle class to pre-select in the booking link (business = Mercedes E-Class, electric = Mercedes EQE, first = Mercedes S-Class, van = Mercedes V-Class, ev = Mercedes EQV; special = on request).

lang.description: Language of messages and of the booking link. One of the 7 website languages: fr, en, ar, es, tr, ru, zh. Texts exist in fr, en, ar, es; tr, ru, zh get English texts (field "lang" of the answer = language served). Names read from the tariff (classes, zones, destinations) that have no version in the language served are given in English and flagged by "name_lang". Booking link: booking form in fr, en, ar, es; English booking form for tr, ru, zh.

type.description: "oneway" (transfer, default) or "hourly": hourly chauffeur hire, a chauffeur at your disposal by the hour, half day or full day ("as directed"; French « mise à disposition », « chauffeur à l'heure ») — "to" not needed; the pickup ("from") can be anywhere in metropolitan France, at the same prices as Paris; from a ski resort (season packages) or outside metropolitan France: status "on_request".

duration.description: Hours of chauffeur hire for the day, 3 to 12, required when type is "hourly" (not with duration_unit "week"). Sold blocks: 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12 hours (e.g. 4 = half day, 8 = full day); any other whole number of hours is priced as the sold block below plus the extra hours at the hourly rate, never above the next block. Included: waiting, 40 km per hour, tolls, fuel; overtime per started half hour at half the hourly rate; kilometres beyond those included charged per km by class, over the whole booking (amounts per class in the answer). The price of a block can be lower than hours × hourly rate.

duration_unit.description: "hours" (default) or "week": a week of hourly hire with the same chauffeur, 6 days × 8 h, pickup in Paris; one weekly price per class, booked on written request (pre-filled quote form). With type "hourly".

tools.name: voir_conditions
tools.description: Service conditions of Precellence Service, generated from the tariff and rules in force: vehicle classes (passengers, luggage, minimum fare, hourly rate), fixed-price zones, long distance, hourly hire (chauffeur at your disposal by the hour, half day or full day: minimum hours, sold durations, block prices per class, km included, overtime per started half hour, price per extra km, weekly rate, Maybach hourly rate), intermediate stops (stopovers, legs, drop-offs on the way, when the tariff in force has them: price per hour started on short trips, legs per km on long trips, bookable on the website only, never priced by obtenir_devis), options, waiting time, cancellation and refunds, booking notice, payment (website only), contacts and links. Read-only; no booking, no payment. FR : conditions du service, arrêts intermédiaires (étapes, escales) compris. AR : شروط الخدمة. ES : condiciones del servicio.

Names read from the tariff (classes, zones, destinations) that have no version in the language served are given in English and flagged by "name_lang". tools.name: voir_forfaits
tools.description: Read-only catalogue of the named chauffeur packages of Precellence Service, Paris, with their prices including VAT per vehicle class, read from the tariff in force: (1) "duration": hourly hire blocks sold online (3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12 hours), with hours, km included, what is included, the overtime and extra-km prices and a booking link template (booking_url_template: the booking form with the duration and class set), and the week (6 days × 8 h, same chauffeur, on written request); (2) "destination": day trips from Paris with an agreed itinerary (Champagne / Reims, Normandy, Mont-Saint-Michel, Versailles), fixed prices, booked on written quote; (3) "season": ski-resort packages of the season (ski-2026-27: day, week and evening with the same chauffeur, resorts and season dates), booked on written quote, flagged "provisional" while the prices are provisional. Each package has an id, a category, prices_ttc per class, pricing_basis, bookable_online, a pre-filled link (booking_url_template or quote_form_url) and its validity (valid_from, tariff_version). No booking, no payment, no external service called. FR : catalogue des forfaits (blocs de mise à disposition, journées à destination, stations de ski), prix TTC par véhicule. AR : قائمة الباقات (ساعات السائق، رحلات اليوم، منتجعات التزلّج)، الأسعار شاملة الضريبة لكل سيارة. ES : catálogo de paquetes (chófer por horas, excursiones de un día, estaciones de esquí), precios con IVA por vehículo.

lang.description: Language of names and links. One of the 7 website languages: fr, en, ar, es, tr, ru, zh. Texts exist in fr, en, ar, es; tr, ru, zh get English texts (field "lang" of the answer = language served). Names read from the tariff (classes, zones, destinations) that have no version in the language served are given in English and flagged by "name_lang". Booking link: booking form in fr, en, ar, es; English booking form for tr, ru, zh.

category.description: "duration" (hourly hire blocks and week), "destination" (day trips with an agreed itinerary) or "season" (ski-resort packages). Omitted: all packages.

season.description: Ski season (category "season"); implies category "season" when category is omitted.
